# Lacuna Digital

> Lacuna Digital is Dave Kelly's independent product design and digital consulting practice in North County Dublin.

Senior product design and AI-assisted build: fixed-price launches from 5 working days; prototypes in 5 days.

## Services & pricing (EUR, + VAT unless stated)

Prices + VAT at 23% unless shown as incl. VAT.
Free 20-minute introductory call and fixed written quote within 48 hours. Digital Health Check €250 (+€100 on site), half credited against custom work.

### Kitchens & Joinery

- Joinery Pro: €3,000 + VAT. Live in 4–5 weeks from site visit.
- Showroom: €5,750 + VAT. Live in 6–8 weeks.

### Clinics & Practices

- Practitioner: €1,550 incl. VAT; or €120/mo × 12. Live in 2 weeks.
- Clinic: €4,300 incl. VAT. Live in 4–6 weeks.
- Clinic Plus: €7,400 incl. VAT. Live in 6–8 weeks.

### Trades & Home services

- Trade Launch: €1,170 incl. VAT; or €90/mo × 12. Live in 7 working days.
- Trade Site: €2,150 incl. VAT; or €170/mo × 12. Live in 3 weeks.

### Salons & Barbers

- Booking Fix: €360 incl. VAT. Live in 5 working days.
- Switch & Save: €800 incl. VAT. Live in 5 working days from your service list and rota.
- Salon Site: €2,350 incl. VAT; or €180/mo × 12. Live in 3 weeks.

### Tours & Experiences

- Direct Booking: €2,000 + VAT. Live in 3 weeks.
- Conversion Revamp: €5,500 + VAT. Live in 6–8 weeks.

### Restaurants & Cafés

- Menu & Google Kit: €550 incl. VAT. Live in 5 working days.
- Order Direct (Flipdish route): €600 + VAT. Live in 2 weeks + Flipdish onboarding.
- Delivery listing tune-up (per platform): €250 + VAT. Live in 5 working days after the platform approves you.

### Web ladder

- Launch: €750 + VAT; or €70/mo × 12. Live in 7 working days.
- Business Site: €2,500 + VAT. Live in 3–4 weeks.
- Business Plus: €5,000 + VAT. Live in 5–6 weeks.
- Bespoke: from €7,500 + VAT. Live in 8–12 weeks.

### Care plans

- Care: €65/month. Hosting, SSL, backups, uptime monitoring; Security updates and .ie renewal; 30 minutes of edits a month; Reply within 1 business day.
- Growth: €200/month. Everything in Care; 60 minutes of edits a month; Review-request flow (asks every customer); Monthly report; One module for your industry.
- Growth + AI: €350/month. Everything in Growth; AI website assistant (up to 200 conversations, says it is an AI); Missed-call text-back; Quarterly 30-minute call.
3-month minimum for salons and restaurants, 6 months for others. Pay a year upfront, get 1 month free. Your domain, your content, your code. Export any time; no exit fee after the minimum term.

### Key add-ons

- Extra page €150; Google profile €350; booking €350; Stripe checkout €450.
- Email setup €150 (2 inboxes); extra inbox €40; migration €75 per mailbox; licences billed directly.
- Social setup €350; posting €200/month (6 posts).
- Delivery listing tune-up €250 per approved platform.
- AI assistant €600 + €100/month (200 conversations); missed-call text-back €50/month.
- AI receptionist €950 + €250/month (300 minutes).
- CRM starter €1,200; brand starter €1,000; copy €100 per page; extra work €100/hour in 30-minute blocks.

### Product Studio

- Day rate €650; agency white-label €600/day (5-day minimum).
- Fractional Product Designer €2,600/month for 4 days (3-month minimum).
- Investor Prototype €3,000 (5 working days); Prototype Sprint €6,000 (3 weeks); 5 moderated tests +€2,500.
- AI-built MVP from €20,000 (6–10 weeks, only after a Prototype Sprint).
- UX & Accessibility Audit: Focused €4,500 (5 days, WCAG 2.2 AA spot check); Comprehensive €9,000.
- Design System Foundation from €18,000 (8 weeks); Digital / AI Discovery Roadmap €4,500 (5 days).
- AI Opportunity Audit €1,250 (about 2 days, half credited against Automation Sprint, up to 15 staff). Automation Sprint typically €3,000–€6,500, fixed price agreed in writing.
- AI Ops €750/month for 8 hours including meetings; 3-month minimum then 30 days' notice; overage €100/hour.
